title: Beyond Description: Federated Adaptation via Semantic-Visual Prototype Alignment

split.decision: Fixed published seed-1 8-shot UCF101 pool, 808 rows. Stratified train_test_split(test_size=0.2,random_state=20261030) materialized as train646/val162. Fixed original K=10,rho=0.1 memberships inherited by retained rows. Frozen ViT-B/16 features. Original evaluation rows unchanged, held by judge. Original row IDs, sorted. Eight-shot is the total labeled pool budget; baseline fits only remaining train; baseline and candidate fits use only the 646 training rows; validation remains held out.

baseline.paper_ref: ICML2026 official poster UCF101 ViT-B/16 FedSPA-G79.1 / FedSPA-P88.0; metric archive mean78.95849854612742 across seeds1,2,3.

allowed_changes: The learned heads, prototype/adaptation method, training surrogate, local optimizer and aggregation strategy may change within the fixed feature, federation and communication setting.

When retaining the supplied FedSPA pipeline, changing only alpha=9, beta=8, local_lr=0.0004, global_lr=0.0004, lam_reg=0.2, temperature tau=0.01, local_batch_size=8, global_batch_size=8, local_epochs=5, local_epochs_last=100 or local_epochs_server=100 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Improve federated UCF101 generalization on frozen CLIP ViT-B/16 features while retaining personalized accuracy.

The supplied frozen image/text embeddings, eight-shot total labeled pool, ten clients with fixed rho=0.1 assignment, ten communication rounds and per-client-per-round upload limit 101*512 floats remain fixed.
Global accuracy is the objective; the unweighted ten-client personalized accuracy must be at least 86.5%.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
